**Bhagavantaṁ sammāsambuddho bhaṇāmase**

**Literal:** the Blessed One the perfectly awakened one let us recite  
**Faithful:** Let us recite to the Blessed One, the perfectly awakened one.  

| Word | Analysis & Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`bhagavantaṁ`** | `(masc acc sg)` the Blessed One; **[√bhaj > bhag + a + vant]** |
| **`sammāsambuddho`** | `(masc nom sg comp)` perfectly awakened one; **[sammā + sambuddha]** |
| ↳ **`dhamm'`** | `(masc comp)` teaching; **[√dhar + ma]** |
| ↳ **`sat'`** | `(fem comp)` mindfulness; **[√sar + ti]** |
| **`bhaṇāmase`** | `(1st pl pres mid imperat)` let us recite; **[√bhaṇ + a + mase]** |
